\begin{equation}\label{eq:B4_MHSE_continuous}

% Well-balanced residual definition
\begin{equation}\label{eq:B4_F_wb_definition}
F_{\mathrm{wb}}(\mathbf{U}) \equiv R(\mathbf{U}) - R(\mathbf{U}_{\mathrm{hse}}),\qquad F_{\mathrm{wb}}(\mathbf{U}_{\mathrm{hse}}) \equiv 0.

% Linear perturbation Jacobian is preserved
\begin{equation}\label{eq:B4_linear_wave_preserved}
\left.\partial_\mathbf{U} F_{\mathrm{wb}}\right|_{\mathbf{U}_{\mathrm{hse}}} = \left.\partial_\mathbf{U} R\right|_{\mathbf{U}_{\mathrm{hse}}},\ \text{so linear MHD waves propagate unchanged.}
\end{equation}

% Practical recipe
